results.name: Editor Scene view state -> FireExt & FireExt_display active in scene asset
Start Fire module -> Step 1 active, display visible, original hidden
Tap extinguisher before hazard/alarm -> Penalty (-5), display stays, no pickup
Identify hazard -> Correct action (+10), Step 2 active, OnHazardIdentified raised
Tap extinguisher before alarm -> Unsafe penalty (-10), display stays, no pickup
Activate alarm -> Step 3 active, extinguisher selection becomes valid, OnAlarmActivated raised
Select extinguisher -> Real extinguisher handoff, follows camera, no duplicates, OnExtinguisherPickedUp raised
Try grip before pin removal -> Penalty (-10 unsafe), grip blocked, OnGripActivated NOT raised
Try spray before pin removal -> Spray blocked, fire active, OnPrematureSprayAttempt raised
Remove pin -> Grip unlocked, Step 5 active, OnPinRemoved raised
Grip extinguisher after pin removed -> Real grip active, OnGripActivated raised
Aim away from fire -> Invalid aim feedback, OnInvalidAim raised
Aim at fire base -> Valid aim, Step 6 active, OnValidAim raised
Spray for 1 second -> Fire remains active
Spray for 9 seconds -> Fire remains active
Spray continuously for >= 10 seconds -> Fire extinguishes, OnFireExtinguished raised
Interrupted spray > 0.35s -> Contact timer resets to 0.0s, OnSprayContactReset raised
Single particle collision (0.016s) -> Fire remains active
Complete all six steps -> NO Step 7, AR completion triggered
Rapid wrong actions -> Debounce prevents multi-frame score drain
Timeout at 420 seconds -> Critical error, OnScenarioTimeout raised
Successful attempt -> Real AR metrics reach AppState
Failed attempt -> Real failure metrics reach AppState
Certificate eligibility rule -> Score >= 80 && Crit == 0 && !TimedOut
Language switching English -> Hindi -> Santali -> Non-empty fallback
Scene placement & alignment defense -> FireExt_display active, FireExt inactive
Pre-alarm tap defense in Step 1 & Step 2 -> FireExt remains strictly inactive
Valid selection handoff -> FireExt_display DISAPPEARS, FireExt APPEARS and ATTACHES
Scenario Reset -> FireExt detaches & becomes inactive, FireExt_display active
